controller_6m.full_quote: By virtue of Rule 10.07 of the Listing Rules, each of our Controlling Shareholders has undertaken to the Stock Exchange and to our Company that, except pursuant to the Global Offering, it will not and will procure that the relevant registered holder(s) (if any) of our Shares in which any of them has a beneficial interest will not, without the prior written consent of the Stock Exchange or unless otherwise in compliance with the requirements of the Listing Rules: (i) in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of its shareholdings in our Company is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the “First Six-Month Period”),
controller_6m.basis: six calendar months from the Listing Date ('ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date'); restricted period commences on the prospectus shareholding-disclosure date, i.e. inclusive of Listing Date
controller_6m.notes: Undertaking text continues on page 292 ('dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of...'). A separate Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement undertaking (page 293) locks up the Controlling Shareholders for 'the date falling twelve months after the Listing Date (the "Lock-up Period")'.

controller_12m.full_quote: (ii) in the period of six months commencing from the expiry of the First Six-Month Period (the “Second Six-Month Period”), dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Relevant Shares to such extent that, immediately following such disposal, or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, it would then cease to be a controlling shareholder of our Company for the purpose of the Listing Rules.
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b) second six-month period: 'six months commencing from the expiry of the First Six-Month Period', i.e. 12 calendar months from the Listing Date; restriction applies to disposals that would cause the holder to cease to be a controlling shareholder
